q-106137.worked_solution:

q-84903.problem: Find the axis of symmetry of the parabola $y=(7-5x)(x+1).$
q-84903.worked_solution:
From the equation $y=(7-5x)(x+1),$ we find that the roots of the parabola are ${x}_{1}=\frac{7}{5}$ and ${x}_{2}=-1.$ 

To find the axis of symmetry, we take the average of the roots, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =\frac{{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}}{2} \\  & =\frac{(\frac{7}{5}-1)}{2} \\  & =\frac{(\frac{7}{5}-\frac{5}{5})}{2} \\  & =\frac{(\frac{2}{5})}{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{5}\end{aligned}
